rubric: A file is PRESENT if some function makes a re-entrant-capable call (CALL/CALLCODE/DELEGATECALL, .call, .call.value, .send with gas above 2300, or an external contract call) and writes storage after that call in the same function. .transfer alone (2300 stipend) does not count. A write before the call with nothing after it does not count. Full-gas CALLs are checked in bytecode with the engine's gas bound (bound above 2300 or unknown). Where bytecode shows a full-gas CALL that the source does not show, the file is UNRESOLVED.
method_note: First-pass ratings grepped only for low-level calls and missed token-interface calls (buggy_33, buggy_42). Corrected in this file. BitCash was viewed with the engine's SWC-107 finding in hand, so its rating is not blinded.
